_meta.source: Atlânticoline line naming and seasonality from public communications. No PDF scraped yet.
_meta.notes: Six named lines: Blue/Green/White year-round, Yellow/Orange/Pink summer. The Pink Line's existence and routing are the least certain — seeded as tentative. The Yellow Line exists (verified) but its extensions to Graciosa and Terceira are tentative and live in line_routes.json.

data.description_en: Daily year-round crossing between Horta (Faial) and Madalena (Pico). The backbone of central-group inter-island travel.
data.description_pt: Travessia diária ao longo do ano entre a Horta (Faial) e a Madalena (Pico). A espinha dorsal das viagens entre ilhas do grupo central.

data.description_en: Year-round triangle connecting Horta, Madalena and Velas (São Jorge). Frequency varies by season.
data.description_pt: Triângulo ao longo do ano ligando Horta, Madalena e Velas (São Jorge). A frequência varia conforme a estação.

data.description_en: Short daily crossing between Santa Cruz das Flores and Vila do Corvo, the only ferry in the western group.
data.description_pt: Travessia curta diária entre Santa Cruz das Flores e Vila do Corvo, o único ferry no grupo ocidental.

data.description_en: Summer central-group circuit linking São Roque, Velas and Calheta, with seasonal extensions to Graciosa and Praia da Vitória.
data.description_pt: Circuito de verão no grupo central, ligando São Roque, Velas e Calheta, com extensões sazonais à Graciosa e à Praia da Vitória.
data.notes: Line exists and operates every summer. Exact stop set and frequencies vary year to year; extensions to Graciosa/Terceira are marked tentative at the line_routes level.

data.description_en: Summer-only short crossing between São Roque (Pico) and Velas (São Jorge).
data.description_pt: Travessia curta apenas no verão entre São Roque (Pico) e Velas (São Jorge).

data.description_en: Occasional summer connection between the western group (Flores) and the central group (Horta). Sailings are sparse and subject to weather.
data.description_pt: Ligação ocasional de verão entre o grupo ocidental (Flores) e o grupo central (Horta). As travessias são raras e sujeitas às condições do mar.
data.notes: Existence and routing inferred from Atlânticoline seasonal communications. Verify against the next published summer PDF before launch. Any UI rendering this line must surface the uncertainty.
